assistant_tool_runs_started_identity_che.name: assistant_tool_runs_started_identity_check
assistant_tool_runs_started_identity_che.value: "assistant_tool_runs"."outcome" <> 'started' OR ("assistant_tool_runs"."execution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assistant_tool_runs"."seq" IS NOT NULL)

company_customers_contact_check.name: company_customers_contact_check
company_customers_contact_check.value: "company_customers"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "company_customers"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "company_customers"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

documents_basis_check.name: documents_basis_check
documents_basis_check.value: "documents"."basis" IS NULL OR char_length("documents"."basis") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

company_customer_invites_personal_check.name: company_customer_invites_personal_check
company_customer_invites_personal_check.value: "company_customer_invites"."is_reusable" = true OR ("company_customer_invites"."max_uses" IS NOT NULL AND "company_customer_invites"."max_uses" = 1)

orders_confirmed_requires_confirmed_at_c.name: orders_confirmed_requires_confirmed_at_check
orders_confirmed_requires_confirmed_at_c.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'in_progress', 'done') OR "orders"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
